construct: THRB variants reduce responsiveness to thyroid hormone in tissues expressing thyroid hormone receptor beta and diminish normal negative feedback at the hypothalamic-pituitary axis. The biochemical signature is elevated free thyroid hormones with an inappropriately normal or elevated TSH rather than TSH suppression.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Repeated elevated free T4/T3 with nonsuppressed TSH, a normal pituitary MRI, and the same stable biochemical phenotype in a first-degree relative support inherited resistance to thyroid hormone beta.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: A TSH-secreting adenoma can produce high thyroid hormone with nonsuppressed TSH, but a normal MRI plus an affected mother and stable familial phenotype strongly favor RTHβ.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: Primary thyrotoxicosis alternatives suppress TSH, while the multigenerational nonsuppressed-TSH pattern makes RTHβ uniquely best.
